issues.description: The UML diagram in problem_statement.md defines the class as 'Course' (lines showing class Course { ... }) while the rest of the exercise (text, template, and solution) consistently refer to the class as 'Lecture'. This identifier mismatch between the UML and the code artifacts can confuse students mapping the diagram to the provided Lecture.java template/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the UML class in problem_statement.md from 'Course' to 'Lecture' (or otherwise make the UML and textual description consistent). Update any UML labels that reference 'Course' so they match the Lecture class name used in the template and solution.
